verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API for retrieval/synthesis and an MCP server exposing the same surface, explicitly marketed as 'API and agent ready' (consensus-docs-16, -29, -15). However, there's no evidence of actual API reference docs (endpoints, auth, schemas) beyond marketing pages, and a docs.md probe returned 404, suggesting thin documentation depth. Missing for 10: detailed API reference/spec, authentication and rate-limit docs, independent developer corroboration of API usage.
